name: Samurai Jito
body:
A jito, is an honorific for a head samurai of a particular area. This samurai excels at leading other samurai.

Retainer (Ex)

At 3rd level, a jito acquires the services of a loyal retainer. This NPC functions similarly to a cohort, though the retainer must advance as a samurai and cannot multi-class until the jito reaches 7th level (though the retainer can select an archetype).

The retainer must follow the same order as the jito.

The retainer gains Swift Aid as a bonus feat, and provides a +2 (rather than +1) bonus when using this feat to aid the jito. As a move action, the retainer can retrieve a stored item or an item on the ground and hand it to the jito. The jito does not have to take an action to receive the item, though they must be conscious and have a free hand. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity for the retainer or jito.

If the retainer dies performing an act that directly supports the edicts of the jito’s order (GM’s discretion), the jito does not take a penalty to their Leadership score. If a retainer dies, or is released from the jito’s service, the jito may gain a new retainer by scouting for potential candidates in a city or large town.

This requires 1 day per 5 levels of the retainer to be recruited.

This ability replaces mount.

Teamwork (Ex)

At 4th level, as long as a jito and their retainer are adjacent, the retainer is treated as having any teamwork feats the jito has. They also share any teamwork feats that function when two or more allies threaten the same target, as long as they both threaten the same target.

This ability replaces mounted archer.

Banner (Ex)

A retainer can carry a jito’s banner for them and still grant allies within range the banner’s bonuses. While doing so the retainer gains double the normal morale bonuses provided by the banner.

This ability modifies banner.
